Practically, 1 $oHENLO gives you a right to purchase 1 $HENLO at a 25% discount to its initial launch price. $HENLO DEX liquidity will be seeded at a price of $0.0002. $oHENLO can be exercised to redeem $HENLO for $0.00015 each. Why $oHENLO and not pure $HENLO? Henlo was designed as not just a memecoin, but a big gateway to Berachain for new users. Users who have been active for a while; including those who hold eligible THJ assets, Bong Bears and rebases, or participated in certain programs, are eligible for pure $HENLO. For new community members, $oHENLO is a way to ensure some skin in the game, and a real interest in onboarding into Berachain and the Henlo community. Secondly, $oHENLO is a way to ensure that our wider community has a guaranteed ability to enter at a fair price, no matter what happens with the market.
